upstream_reachability.http: curl -L https://www.samsung.com/us/ -> HTTP 200; catalog, buy, spec and support endpoints all answered 200 to coherent browser-header requests
upstream_reachability.conclusion: the declared upstream is live and reachable, so the mirror is a real capture; no fixture fallback was used and none was needed

capture_method: direct HTTP GETs (curl / requests, Chrome UA) against the live HTML pages, plus the public JSON APIs the live pages themselves load: the product-finder search API (sribsrch.ecom.samsung.com estoresearch pf_search) for the eight catalogs, the buy-tool __NEXT_DATA__ payloads embedded in the live /buy/ pages for the configurators, the spec-compare and family-list APIs (searchapi.samsung.com v6) for the Galaxy specification tables, and the static support / warranty / legal pages. No headless browser was required; no WAF bypass was needed (plain coherent requests were served).

www.samsung.com/us/.role: primary site: home page heroes, the eight catalog hubs, product pages, buy configurators, support home, warranty center, contact page

sribsrch.ecom.samsung.com (estoresearch.role: the product-finder API the live catalog grids load: full result sets for Smartphones (42 SKUs), Tablets (11), Watches (14), Audio (3), Mobile Accessories (314), TVs (42), Laundry (39) and Refrigerators (40) — 505 real SKUs with names, model codes, prices, ratings, review counts, series and facet filters

www.samsung.com/us/.../buy/ (__NEXT_DATA.role: the live buy-tool payloads for six flagship configurators: Galaxy S26 Ultra (45 variants), Galaxy S26 (83), Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra (31), Galaxy Z Flip8 (26), Galaxy Tab S11 (12) and Galaxy Watch9 (16) — 213 real model codes with prices, stock state, ratings and the full storage/color/carrier option trees
www.samsung.com/us/.../buy/ (__NEXT_DATA.note: the /buy/ URLs for two Bespoke refrigerator models redirect to their product pages on the live site (no configurator is served there), so no refrigerator configurator is shipped; the six shipped configurators are exactly the ones the live site serves

searchapi.samsung.com/v6 (mktpd spec + f.role: the specification tables the live compare tool renders: 25 Galaxy model families (SM-S948, SM-S947, SM-S942, SM-F976, SM-F971, SM-F776, ... SM-S711) with 1,775 spec rows (display, weight, storage, camera, battery, processor, durability, connectivity, Galaxy AI), plus the family list that maps every model code to its marketing name

www.samsung.com/us/support/legal/ (LGL10.role: the real standard-limited-warranty legal text (limitations of remedies, implied-warranty terms, Samsung Electronics America contact block) quoted by the warranty center

images.samsung.com / image-us.samsung.co.role: all imagery: 505 catalog card images, 213 buy-page variant images, 4 home heroes, the warranty-checker category icons and the site logo
images.samsung.com / image-us.samsung.co.note: every file was fetched from the exact upstream URL it renders at; identical upstream artwork reused across variants is stored once and referenced by every page that uses it; seven upstream files are served with a .png URL but JPEG bytes and are stored under their true extension

content.note: every content record in source_data/*.json is derived from the real captures above; nothing is invented

benchmark_users.note: the four benchmark accounts (alice.j / bob.c / carol.d / dana.k @test.com, password TestPass123!) follow the shared WebHarbor benchmark-user convention (frozen bcrypt hash so the seed DB stays byte-reproducible); their fixture orders, wishlist entries and support tickets are account-surface infrastructure, not upstream content

images.note: all 825 images under static/images/ were downloaded from the upstream CDNs; asset_inventory.json records per-file sha256, bytes and the exact source URL, and scripts/check_asset_inventory.py enforces exact coverage, hash integrity and real format headers at image build time

determinism.seed: the SQLite seed is materialized at image build time (PYTHONHASHSEED=0, no wall clock, no RNG in any seed row; order / ticket timestamps are fixed strings, runtime timestamps belong to runtime rows only) and is byte-identical across resets
determinism.transforms: scripts_dev/build_source_data.py converts the raw captures in scraped_data/ (gitignored) into the tracked source_data/*.json byte-reproducibly; scripts_dev/build_contract.py regenerates verify/contract.json from the seed digest and the honest-path audit answers

registration.declared_slot: audit-wave slot: index 219 / port 40219 (origin/main site count 145 at PR time + audit position 75 - 1 per the standing parallel-wave merge order; the pre-freeze normalization 133/40133 was the 134-site collision caliber recorded by the r1/r2 reviews, reconciled by merge order as with the other in-flight waves)

verification.tasks: 20 seven-key rows (web_name / id / ques / web / upstream_url / verifier_path / judge_rubric) in sites/samsung/tasks.jsonl
verification.honest_steps: scripts_dev/validate_tasks.py drives every task's honest path twice on fresh databases: 330 atomic actions total, min 15 / max 20 per task, both rounds agreeing; reads are never counted and no task can be finished in fewer than 15 honest steps
verification.contract: verify/contract.json + verify/verify_N.py grade browser evidence (page paths, decoded screenshots), scoped factual claims and exact database deltas against the reviewed seed; scripts_dev/walk_tasks.py proves all 20 tasks pass the verifier in two independent rounds
